messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up team — were kicking off a limited A/B pricing experiment tomorrow 09:00 PT targeting early-beta and partner cohorts. Need explicit grandfathering rules.
Jordan Lee: Confirming cohorts: early-beta, partners. Any exclusions?
Maya Patel: Exclude accounts with account.meta.grandfather_exempt = true and any manual billing overrides.
Liam O'Connor: Vendor file uploaded: /sheets/vendor_rates_v4.csv. Noted one row had missing currency; fixed and re-uploaded.
Jordan Lee: @Liam can you trigger billing-bot to regenerate invoice previews after the fix?
Liam O'Connor: billing-bot: regen preview requested -> preview_id=prv_20240315_ab_v1
billing-bot: [automated] Invoice preview ready: https://redwood.internal/preview/prv_20240315_ab_v1
Maya Patel: Checklist for go: 1) grandfather_flag=true for eligible accounts, 2) no retro billing edits, 3) refund/escalation path documented.
Jordan Lee: Eligibility filter proposed: created_before=2023-11-01 AND promo=legacy_beta. OK?
Maya Patel: Yes. Also ensure we holdback 25% of traffic in canary for 48h.
Ana Gomez: Need concise note for finance leadership summarizing risks and rollback (<6 lines).
Jordan Lee: Draft: "A/B experiment on tiered pricing for early-beta+partners. Risk: ~100-150 accounts may see price changes. Mitigation: 25% canary, monitor invoice delta, immediate rollback to legacy pricing and manual invoice revocation if severe. Refunds >$250 require finance approval."
Ana Gomez: Add telemetry requirements: tokenized usage delta, avg invoice change, top-10 impacted accounts.
Liam O'Connor: Added metrics to dashboard /dashboards/pricing/ab_grandfathering. Alerts set: avg_delta > $50 OR pct_impacted > 3% -> pager.
Jordan Lee: Approvals: @Ana can you approve the grandfathering exception and holdback so SRE can schedule?
Ana Gomez: Approved (Finance ID: FA-2024-0315). Proceed with canary under holdback.
Maya Patel: Ops: schedule at 09:00 PT, lock transfers at 08:30. If billing-bot reports schema or missing rows, abort and notify #finance immediately. :warning:
billing-bot: [automated] Scheduled job queued: job_id=job_2142223500, run_at=2024-03-15T16:00:00Z
Jordan Lee: Post-run: reconcile preview vs final invoices. Ill open TICK-3246 for any discrepancies >$250 and tag CS for customer reachouts.
Maya Patel: Also need a CS canned message explaining grandfathering and the refund escalation flow. Liam?
Liam O'Connor: Draft complete, will post to #customer-success in 10m.
Ana Gomez: Keep monitoring tight for 2 hours post-deploy. Leave hourly updates in this thread.
Jordan Lee: Acknowledged — will post H1 update at +1h.
Maya Patel: Final: vendor CSV ✅, preview ✅, finance approval FA-2024-0315 ✅. Canary go at 09:00 PT.
